messages:
Jordan L: Heads up, onboarding repro for the new eval-kit (next + langchain example): requests to the hosted API get stuck in a retry loop when using ephemeral keys from the console. Page never errors, just keeps spinning. Anyone seen this?
Maya S: repro steps? browser / node / next version?
Jordan L: Next 14.3, node 20, cloned repo from `examples/eval-kit-next`. Ran devcontainer, set REDWOOD_API_KEY=ephemeral key (copied from console), npm run dev, open /playground and submit prompt. UI waits forever.
Tom H: logs? looks like a double-retry + missing short-circuit after successful refresh we've seen before.
Jordan L: server log snippet: ```[2026-02-26T09:11:05Z] WARN token refresh invoked
[2026-02-26T09:11:05Z] ERROR request failed: 401 Unauthorized
[2026-02-26T09:11:05Z] INFO retrying request (attempt 2)
[2026-02-26T09:11:05Z] ERROR request failed: 502 Bad Gateway
[2026-02-26T09:11:05Z] INFO retrying request (attempt 3)
...```
Priya D: That pattern means the TS SDK hits the refresh endpoint (200) but doesn't clear the in-flight retry state so subsequent 401/502s trigger more retries instead of honoring the refresh. Python client has a guard for this.
Maya S: confirm SDK versions? examples pin `@redwood/inference-js@0.9.3-beta` in package.json.
Tom H: I can repro. Quick patch I'm testing: after a refresh success, set a flag `refreshedAt = Date.now()` and change `shouldRetry` to return false for 401 within 2s of refresh. Stops the spin.
Jordan L: Nice. Could add small unit test that simulates refresh race.
Priya D: opened PR #1538 with tests + changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1538 — CI passed on linux/mac, flaky on windows but logs look OK.
CI Bot: PR #1538 77 CI passed  all tests green  merge ready.
Maya S: two DX follow-ups: 1) eval-kit README doesn't explain ephemeral token TTLs or `devcontainer` copy step (users paste short-lived token into env and then wonder why it fails). 2) streaming example in the Next sample doesn't AbortController abort on route change so sockets pile up in dev.
Jordan L: I'll send a small README PR to add a "Dev env gotchas" section listing token TTL and a one-liner workaround: `export REDWOOD_ALLOW_SHORT_RETRY_FIX=1` until SDK patch ships. Also include expected server log sample so people can triage.
Tom H: filing follow-up issue for streaming cancel and telemetry noise: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/issues/402 — includes a suggested fix using `AbortController` and call `fetch.abort()` on unmount.
Priya D: FYI product asked we don't block the bootcamp release; we can ship content with a prominent note and link to PR #1538. But we should flip the example to include the workaround by default in a branch.
Jordan L: Agree. I'll update the example branch and add a small e2e that runs the sample and checks it responds within 5s.
Maya S: thanks all. Ping here when the README + example branch is updated and when PR merges so we can mark the bootcamp checklist item done. :thumbsup:
